# Cale AI Workbench 0.24.13 for Windows

Music Studio opens the DJ Mixer as a pair of amber and cyan vinyl turntables. Each track has its own waveform, transport and EQ. The channel faders and crossfader sit between the decks. Select **1 + 2** or **3 + 4** to reach all four decks. Click a loaded platter to play or pause, or an empty platter to load a track. The Song library still loads and blends saved recordings.

- The layout adapts to smaller windows and respects reduced-motion preferences.
- Paused decks now request a native snapshot about once every two seconds. Active playback still requests updates about every 400 milliseconds. Unchanged titles and status text retain their DOM nodes.
- Rapid play requests on separate DJ decks now share the same audio handover. One deck can no longer cancel the other while radio or preview playback releases the output.
- Fixed a layout defect found during testing that could collapse the artwork to zero width while leaving the controls visible.

## Verification

37 Chromium controller and interface checks and 28 native DJ tests passed. Two additional native audio tests captured the outgoing and incoming tracks during a blend and decoded all eight sampler pads. The desktop rehearsal loaded two local WAV files across four decks, verified simultaneous playback and Pause all, exercised cue, hot cue, EQ, the channel and crossfaders, and checked four window sizes from 660 to 1568 pixels wide.
Source commit f0a7beb54a53990760318e9b7c2e8b81c3b8d3ac.
A separate desktop check synced a 120 BPM deck to a playing 132 BPM reference at 110% speed, exercised a complete loop toggle cycle, and triggered and stopped a sampler pad.
In a side-by-side Chromium check of the previous and revised paused controllers, the old mixer sent 25 snapshot requests in 10.05 seconds. The revised mixer sent 5.
